_doc: The delivery profile of the project ultra-epic was built on: a sailing race-timing product with iOS and Android apps, a React admin site, a Supabase backend and serverless functions. Kept as a worked example. Repo name, project refs and paths are placeholders.
name: Flying Start

live.description: the hosted Supabase project and the production Netlify sites

lenses: RLS, SECURITY DEFINER functions, anon reach, cross-club access, officer-only RPCs, new tables without GRANTs or RLS
XSS sinks, SQL built from strings, URL or host built from input, open redirects, unsafe deep links, function input
secrets in code or logs, personal data in URLs or analytics, email or push to real addresses, delete paths, payment webhooks
logic errors, wrong conditions, off-by-one, nil/null paths, error handling, concurrency, timer and clock handling
each child issue's Given/When/Then against the code
iOS vs Android feature, UI and UX parity for every user-visible change; the web app where it shares the flow
Supabase queries, sync, realtime, migrations (IF NOT EXISTS, GRANTs, order), enum/CHECK values, offline paths
tests that cannot fail, expected values copied from the code, missing negative cases, drivers whose checks do not match the scenario
SwiftUI state in timer closures, Picker bindings, Compose recomposition, React effects, strings not in the string catalogues

capacity.device_rules: Boot a simulator only with `sh examples/flying-start/capacity_sim.sh boot <udid>` (one boot at a time across all agents: parallel boots silently fail). Create your own simulator, named <epic>-<lane>, and delete it at the end. Never shut down all simulators.

steps: Fetch; the remote main must still equal base_main, else merge it into the epic again and re-run the stale gates.
Merge the epic onto main locally with the default message; the merge tree must equal the epic head.
Apply each approved migration to the hosted database in number order, one transaction each, and verify with a SELECT. No test or probe on live.
Regenerate the database types from live and check only the schema delta changed.
Run the deploy gates (string catalogue drift, RLS gate) in the main checkout.
git push origin main (the guard checks the gates once more).
Check the hosting provider's deploy status for each touched site. Store submissions stay with the human.
